column1: # Which MITRE ATT&CK for ICS technique each TechDetechtives Suricata rule belongs to.
# One row per rule and technique; a rule may have several rows. Checked against
# ics-attack.json by tools/attack_ics.py and by the tests.
# fit: direct  = the rule matches the network operation the technique is carried out with
#      related = it matches something that goes with the technique
#                operation of which the technique is only one use
# technique "-" = looked at and left without a technique; 'why' says why.
# An alert is tagged with its rule's first row and every direct row. td_attack_fit in the
# alert says whether the first row is direct or related.
